data.summary:
Experienced Workday consultant with a superb track record of delivering workday integration, HCM, and Studio implementation solutions that
fuel business growth. Demonstrated excellence in adapting to changing team and organizational needs to deliver exceptional results.
Passionate about leveraging technology to drive transformative change in the Hospitals/Healthcare/Diagnostics industry.

responsibilities: Used sequence generators, generating templates and validating inbound integration system results and Worked on regression testing on various tenants includes Sandbox, SandboxPreview.
Involved in creating the custom reports as per the client requirements and in creating the integration based on localization.
I have also participated in inhouse integration implementation and monitoring part.
Involved in creating custom fields which has complex logic and used for custom reports.
Involved in creating the technical design documents for the integrations based on the functional design documents.

Worked on creating EIB integrations, Core connectors and Document transformations using XSLT & XPATH and configured Integration security, security segments, user-based security groups, Integration System users.
Worked on complex studio enhancements.
Created job profiles, sup orgs, locations, hire and termination to help client to test the integration thoroughly.
Worked closely with integration to build payroll integration for different countries.
Worked on several functional tasks. Working on payroll integrations such as PECI and PICOF.
Created several BAU reports for vendors.
Working rigorously on monitoring integrations and doing enhancements for HCM side.
I am working here in both supporting in-house project also implementation of any integration as per need.
Developed integration from scratch using workday connectors.
Developed Adobe Sign integration to provide e-signature feature on workday documents.
Worked end-to-end on ServiceNow HR Spoke Connector.
Lead the design sessions for various integrations.
Created design and mapping documentation for several integrations.
Experienced in workday studio. Worked with web services like payroll inputs, payment elections etc.
Carry working experience in building third party payroll integrations using PECI.
Came with workday implementation project experience.
